subject: general
question: In which of the following years, Queen Victoria's Proclamation declared that thereafter India would be governed by and in the name of the British Monarch through a secretary of State?
solution:
Correct answer is__** 1858.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Queen Victoria's Proclamation **of **1 November 1858** announced that then India would be governed by and in the name of the British Monarch through a Secretary of State.
 
• Government of India Act, 1858 is also famous as **the act of good governance**.
 
• Parliament to hand over administrative control of **British India from the East India Company.**
 
• The act made India a direct British Colony and **scraped the dual government **proposed by Pitt's India Act of 1784.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Pitt's India Act **established the system of dual control of India** and these changes continued through 1858.
 
• The Government of India Act 1919 was **an act of the British Parliament that sought to increase the participation of Indians in the administration of their country**.
 
• The Government of **India Act, of 1935** was an Act adapted from the Parliament of the **United Kingdom**.​
